en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal in front of a Gothic brick church complex with steep roofs and a tall spire. The church stands directly on the waterfront, with a low fence along the canal and several small figures walking near the entrance. To the left are smaller houses and an industrial-looking chimney. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as a church in Bruges, and red publisher information appears at the bottom.
